turns.text: Hello. The limited print arrived creased. I want a reprint, not my money back.
Hello, I am sorry the print arrived creased. To file a damage claim, I need your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with.
Order SC-5221, email valeska.taranu@example.com. Delivery was within the last two weeks.

Thank you, Valeska. I have filed a damage claim (R-1) for order SC-5221, the limited print Aurora de iarnă, asking for a reprint because it arrived creased. Staff must approve it. They will ask you for a photo of the damage and decide on the reprint. You will hear from us once they have reviewed it.

rule.ro: Un print deteriorat sau tipărit greșit se semnalează în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul primește o retipărire sau banii înapoi. Echipa cere o fotografie și aprobă soluția.
rule.en: Report a damaged or misprinted print within 14 days of delivery. The customer gets a reprint or a refund. Staff ask for a photo and approve.

change.description: Limited print 'Aurora de iarnă' (50x70 cm) arrived creased. Customer requests a reprint.

turns.text: Please file the damage claim with a reprint. I can send a photo to the team.

Your damage claim with a reprint request is already filed as R-1 for order SC-5221, so there is no need to file it again. Staff will ask you for a photo of the creased print and will decide on the reprint. It is pending their approval.
One side question: are limited drops ever restocked? Answer that, then I will come back to the claim.
Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved. Your claim R-1 remains pending, and you can come back to it any time.

rule.ro: Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva.
rule.en: Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

turns.text: I have changed my mind. I want a full refund for the damaged print. If the claim is already on file for a reprint, please change its remedy to a refund.

I cannot change the remedy myself. Refunds above 1000 lei need a decision from a person, and your order total is 1320 lei. I have passed your case to a colleague with the details of claim R-1, including your wish for a full refund instead of a reprint. A colleague will take over and contact you.

error.message: A person decides any refund above 1000 lei. Hand the conversation over with reason staff_decision.

input.summary: Customer Valeska Țăranu (verified, order SC-5221, total 1320 RON, limited print Aurora de iarnă 50x70 cm, delivered 2026-11-08) reported the print arrived creased. Damage claim R-1 was filed with a reprint remedy and is pending approval; staff must ask for a photo. The customer now wants a full refund instead. Changing the remedy to refund was refused by the system because refunds above 1000 lei need a person's decision. Please decide the remedy and contact the customer.
